lessonRef.subject: ready-for-life
lessonRef.title: Unit performance task: reviewing the month honestly

standardsRefs: Manuel Academy local Ready for Life composition
objective: I can complete a realistic reviewing the month honestly task, document the result with minimal private data, and revise a step that does not meet the lesson criteria.
scenario: The learner compiles the month's budget, meal plan, maintenance judgments, transport plan, and disruption response into one written review, then reviews it with an adult who checks that the plan is internally coherent and offers one piece of feedback — not whether the invented dollar figures match real prices.
safetyNotes: The review checks whether the fictional plan is internally coherent, not whether its invented numbers match real prices — no real financial data is needed for this check.

simulationAlternative.description: If no adult is available for a live review today, the learner completes a structured self-review using the same coherence checklist the adult would use, and schedules the adult review for as soon as one is available; the self-review carries equal credit for completing this lesson.

materials: adult-or-local: all of the month's household-simulation artifacts

tasks.directions: Analyze the complete worked example on swk-rfl-g12-u02-l06-model-card before beginning.

prompts.text: Name the first move in the model and explain why it comes first.

tasks.directions: Complete the fictional coached case on swk-rfl-g12-u02-l06-guided-card, use criterion-specific feedback, and finish its fresh correction turn.

prompts.text: Name the move you completed and the success check it meets.

tasks.directions: Choose the permitted real-life route or complete fictional route on swk-rfl-g12-u02-l06-independent-card; follow every step and retain only the named minimal evidence.

prompts.text: Which complete route did you use?
Record the completed step numbers and one non-sensitive result statement.

tasks.directions: Complete the minimal evidence record on swk-rfl-g12-u02-l06-evidence-record; omit or fictionalize private details.

prompts.text: Being honest, not just optimistic: could this plan have actually run for a real month, or where would it likely have broken down?

remediation: Compare the missed move with the worked move on swk-rfl-g12-u02-l06-model-card; name one observable difference and review only the matching instruction step. Complete the affected move on swk-rfl-g12-u02-l06-guided-card with one coach prompt and receive feedback tied to the success check. Name the observable move that now meets the check and the one move, if any, that still needs correction. Do not use shame, trait, effort, or character judgments. Complete the same move on the fresh parallel condition in swk-rfl-g12-u02-l06-retry-pair without the coach prompt. Exit: The supported and parallel moves both meet the named success check: Assembly completeness: All five pieces are present and assembled into one coherent review. | Honest self-assessment: The final reflection names a specific, genuine weak point. Resume at the next unfinished step on swk-rfl-g12-u02-l06-independent-card. A physical task resumes only with required permission and supervision; otherwise finish the equal-credit fictional route.
extension: Have the learner write a one-paragraph 'month two' preview describing what they would change going into a second simulated month, based on this review.

productionDepth.practicalGoal: I can complete a realistic reviewing the month honestly task, document the result with minimal private data, and revise a step that does not meet the lesson criteria.

duration.sessionPattern: 8–10 minutes model and planning, 8–10 minutes guided try, 20–30 minutes application, 7–10 minutes evidence and revision
duration.adultTime: 10–20 minutes for permission, required supervision or review, and physical-event attestation

localMaterials.label: all of the month's household-simulation artifacts
localMaterials.availabilityRule: Use only when already available, safe, permitted, and appropriate. The complete fictional route replaces unavailable real-world access.

materials.noPurchaseRule: No purchase is required. Use the complete fictional route when a local material, setting, source, or adult is unavailable.

resources.title: reviewing the month honestly worked model
resources.purpose: Shows the starting condition, visible moves, reasoning, and success check before the learner begins.
content: Starting condition: The learner compiles the month's budget, meal plan, maintenance judgments, transport plan, and disruption response into one written review, then reviews it with an adult who checks that the plan is internally coherent and offers one piece of feedback — not whether the invented dollar figures match real prices.
Model move 1: Read the condition and name the exact reviewing the month honestly decision or action.
Model move 2: Before the review, predict what an outside reader would flag first.
Model move 3: Assemble the month's artifacts into one written review and walk through it with an adult (or self-review).
Model check: Assembly completeness: All five pieces are present and assembled into one coherent review. | Honest self-assessment: The final reflection names a specific, genuine weak point.

resources.title: reviewing the month honestly action steps
resources.purpose: Provides the ordered directions used by the model, guided attempt, independent task, and retry.
content: 1. Read the goal, constraints, and privacy boundary for reviewing the month honestly.
2. Analyze the worked model and identify why its sequence meets the criteria.
3. Complete the guided case and use feedback before moving on.
4. Select the permitted real-life route or the complete fictional route.
5. Carry out the task, retaining only the minimum evidence named in the record.
6. Compare the result with the success checks and complete the correction loop when needed.

resources.title: reviewing the month honestly coached first attempt
resources.purpose: Carries the complete first attempt and a fresh correction turn.
content: Fictional practice condition: The learner compiles the month's budget, meal plan, maintenance judgments, transport plan, and disruption response into one written review, then reviews it with an adult who checks that the plan is internally coherent and offers one piece of feedback — not whether the invented dollar figures match real prices.
Coach direction: Before the review, predict what an outside reader would flag first.
Learner prompt: If someone else read your whole month's plan for the first time, what part do you predict they'd question first?
Feedback check: name the move completed, point to the matching success check, and identify one missing or uncertain step without judging the learner.
Fresh correction turn: use the same fictional condition with one constraint changed; restate the changed constraint, redo only the affected step, and check the new result.

resources.title: reviewing the month honestly complete application
resources.purpose: Contains the lesson-specific application directions and prompts; it is the delivered card referenced by the learner flow.
content: Application direction: Assemble the month's artifacts into one written review and walk through it with an adult (or self-review).
Response 1 (t2-p1): I assembled the budget, meal plan, maintenance judgments, transport plan, and disruption response into one written review.
Response 2 (t2-p2): I reviewed it with an adult, or completed the structured self-review checklist.

Equal-access rule: If no adult is available for a live review today, the learner completes a structured self-review using the same coherence checklist the adult would use, and schedules the adult review for as soon as one is available; the self-review carries equal credit for completing this lesson.

resources.title: reviewing the month honestly minimal evidence record
resources.purpose: Defines exactly what the learner saves and what must not be collected.
content: Record only: selected route, completed step numbers, one non-sensitive result statement, and one revision if a step changed.
Reflection: Being honest, not just optimistic: could this plan have actually run for a real month, or where would it likely have broken down?
Success checks: Assembly completeness: All five pieces are present and assembled into one coherent review. | Honest self-assessment: The final reflection names a specific, genuine weak point.
Do not collect: names, signatures, addresses, or exact locations; account, identification, medical, product, or medicine details; photos, audio, video, passwords, or private household schedules.

resources.title: reviewing the month honestly supported and parallel retry cards
resources.purpose: Delivers a real correction loop rather than a direction to try again without support.
content: Contrast reteach: compare the model check on swk-rfl-g12-u02-l06-model-card with the missed or unsupported step; name the one observable difference.
Supported card: return to swk-rfl-g12-u02-l06-guided-card, complete the affected move with one coach prompt, and receive criterion-specific feedback.
Parallel card: use a fresh fictional reviewing the month honestly condition with one changed constraint; complete the same move without the coach prompt.

Exit check: the corrected move meets this lesson's checks — Assembly completeness: All five pieces are present and assembled into one coherent review. | Honest self-assessment: The final reflection names a specific, genuine weak point..
Return: resume at the next unfinished step on swk-rfl-g12-u02-l06-independent-card; a physical route resumes only when the authorized adult says it is safe.

retry.trigger: Start the correction loop when a required step is missing, the reason does not match the condition, a safety or privacy boundary is crossed, or the evidence does not show the stated result.
retry.targetedReteach: Compare the missed move with the worked move on swk-rfl-g12-u02-l06-model-card; name one observable difference and review only the matching instruction step.
retry.supportedReattempt: Complete the affected move on swk-rfl-g12-u02-l06-guided-card with one coach prompt and receive feedback tied to the success check.
retry.feedback: Name the observable move that now meets the check and the one move, if any, that still needs correction. Do not use shame, trait, effort, or character judgments.
retry.parallelReattempt: Complete the same move on the fresh parallel condition in swk-rfl-g12-u02-l06-retry-pair without the coach prompt.

guardianInvolvement.role: Give permission; provide only the supervision, handling, review, or observation named in the lesson; attest only that the physical event occurred.
guardianInvolvement.signOffBoundary: A guardian attestation certifies only that the named physical event occurred. It never scores the learner reflection or proves effort, honesty, maturity, responsibility, diagnosis, or character.

safety.stopRule: Stop the physical route when permission, supervision, a safe setting, or an expected material is missing, or when a new hazard appears. Continue only when the authorized adult resolves it; otherwise use the complete fictional route.
safety.physicalBoundary: The learner follows the source safety notes and never performs adult-only handling, transport, account, legal, medical, heat, sharp-tool, electrical, chemical, or machine actions.
safety.noShameRule: Describe only the observable step, condition, evidence, or revision. Never label the learner, household, body, ability, effort, maturity, responsibility, or character.

privacy.rule: Collect the smallest process record that shows the lesson steps. A learner may choose fictional details and may decline private disclosure without losing credit.
doNotCollect: names, signatures, addresses, or exact locations
account, identification, medical, product, or medicine details
photos, audio, video, passwords, or private household schedules

may: coach the guided and retry cards
mayNot: observe or claim a physical condition
tutorBoundary.physicalCompletionRule: Tutor or AI may coach. Tutor or AI may not certify that a real-world physical action occurred.
tutorBoundary.missingResourceAction: Stop and name the unresolved resource. Do not fabricate it; use another complete delivered route only when every resource for that route resolves.
